notes: Pure public-API Annex C.7 Create Federation Execution witnesses use schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules. Focused MinGW CTest and installed-package direct runs pass 8/8 each across HLA_EVOKED/HLA_IMMEDIATE. Java parity still covers the duplicate and conflict scenarios but does not assert the new unique-name merge branch. This contract does not assert other Java providers, update scheduling, arbitrary conflict variants, interoperability, or conformance.
